markdown: **Activate—Group Voyage** <actions string="" /> 10 minutes ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** As you activate the pack, you can harness up to four willing creatures to the ropes on the pack. At the end of the activation time, the pack casts a 7th-rank [_interplanar teleport_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1576) or _teleport_ spell, transporting you and everyone attached to the pack. Attempt a DC 45 Survival check. On a success, you arrive 25 miles off target using _interplanar teleport_ or halve the distance you're off-target with _teleport_. On a critical success, you arrive exactly on target.
name: 10 minutes (concentrate, manipuldate)
